services.name: What Is CrossFit
services.desc: Entry to our group class begins with our Foundations Program. This 4x 1hr session Personal Training program will introduce you to the movements of CrossFit, the community and the culture at CFQB, and ensure you feel confident and prepared to join a group class. In Foundations, you will: Get to know a few of our Training Staff * Discuss and assess any physical limitations you may have * Learn how to adapt and modify many of the common movements seen in a CrossFit class Upon registration, you will receive a CFQB t-shirt!
